title: Add compact RAG authoring workshop with live snapshot prober and CLI
author: Aisha Kumar
description: Introduce a compact, hands-on RAG authoring workshop that ships with a lightweight CLI snapshot prober for live smoke testing, plus a concise docs site tutorial and telemetry probe presets. Includes workshop content (step exercises, sample indexes, prompt variants), a 'snapshot-prober' CLI used to capture and replay minimal traces for iterative authoring, and docsite integration for step-by-step guided lessons.
body: Context: Authoring teams need a portable, low-friction starter that demonstrates RAG authoring best practices while letting them validate changes with quick, reproducible probes. This PR adds a compact workshop package and an opinionated 'snapshot-prober' CLI to make local authoring feedback loops fast. Summary: 1) quickstarts/compact-rag-workshop: guided lessons, seed data, sample prompts and expected assertions; 2) tools/snapshot-prober: a tiny Go/TS CLI that records a minimal session snapshot (query, retrieved docs, model prompt) and can replay it against local or hosted endpoints for smoke validation; 3) docs/site/snippets/workshop.md: docsite page with embedded run instructions and telemetry probe examples; 4) ci/smoke-probers.yml: CI job to run a small set of snapshots against PR deployments. Motivation: reduce authoring feedback iteration time, provide reproducible smoke tests for prompt/regression checks, and offer a low-barrier workshop for new teams. Checklist: - [x] Add workshop exercises and sample index - [x] Implement snapshot-prober CLI (record/replay) - [x] Docsite tutorial + live-play instructions - [x] Add telemetry probe presets and example traces - [x] Add CI smoke job that runs a subset of snapshots on PRs Usage: clone repo, cd quickstarts/compact-rag-workshop, npm install && npm run seed-index, run tools/snapshot-prober record --out=./snapshots/test1.json --query="What is the policy for refunds?" then modify prompts and run tools/snapshot-prober replay --target=http://localhost:8080 --in=./snapshots/test1.json to validate. CI: smoke-probers.yml executes 3 snapshots (fast) against the preview environment; failures mark the PR as failing. Rollout/compatibility: purely additive quickstart and tooling, no runtime library changes. Release notes: Adds compact workshop and snapshot-prober CLI to enable fast RAG authoring feedback loops. Backport: none required.
